handoff.summary: Hecke v2's completed literal-generator witness changes remain unchanged, including prior 44-assertion exact checks on local 0.39.22 and retained pinned 0.40.0. The PARI extension emits fixed-schema exact JSON with rational power-basis factors, ideal basis columns, native class order, torsion-first units, and retained reduction multipliers; strict versioned validation and normalization preserve legacy discovery meaning. PARI regulator remains approximate and only the final batch iteration is retained. Fresh offline receipts pass 42 runner tests (eight PARI test groups), 19 persistent tests, and strict Python (389 modules). After coordinator review and explicit diagnostic extensions, unchanged committed source passes the complete local PARI 2.17.1 five-field smoke: 11 frames, five nontrivial reduction-multiplier mutations, mixed torsion/free coordinates, and 133 decoded exact-array replay assertions (43 literal ideal equations, 43 witness mutations, 10 class powers, 15 units and 22 basis/order checks). Full platform/build and M0 qualification remain draft, not claimed.
risks: This is structural screening, conditional on GRH, not independent replay or qualified benchmark evidence; historical native-text/v1 timings do not measure the strengthened v2 work. PARI stores only the final iteration and its regulator is not an enclosure.

All three initial GP failures remain retained (0.227469548 seconds total). Following full coordinator source review, an explicitly authorized final tranche allowed two further <=180-second invocations; one invocation completed both the full smoke and decoded exact-array replay in 0.123751382 seconds, so no fifth process was needed. No acceptance, proof, or resource limit was relaxed. Local GP 2.17.1 is not a deployed 2.15.x or cross-platform runtime attestation.
